data.title: Plan the live input recording adapter
data.body:
Prepare the next live-input recording adapter plan after the accepted transcript importer.

Create only docs/implementation/live-recording-adapter-plan.md. Read the complete creative-input, live timeline, controlled-replay and live-input capture plans. Inspect the delivered transcript importer, mapping and timeline owners, and the actual runtime input and publication owners. LUX-82 integrated the importer from source 2bd21901a2cf258e373811a91f1514dfb8699ab3.

Define the I02c3b recording boundary against actual runtime calls. Preserve original receipts before coalescing, event order, source authority changes, clock epochs, complete base and host values, and explicit loss or incomplete endings. Identify the exact owner that can witness whether timeline, mapping and runtime publication committed together. A self-consistent supplied transcript is not proof of collection or publication. Do not invent a transaction or runtime identity that the current source does not provide.

Select a coherent first source leaf with exact files, APIs, types, limits, failures and reachable CPU fixtures. Record any required runtime owner prerequisite with source evidence. Separate pure adapter tests from actual live recording, storage, device, hardware and pixel validation. Keep hashing and truthful collection claims separate. Use read-only probes of actual owners and controlled seams.

Do not implement application source, add a device provider, file persistence, runtime execution, Studio, MCP, SDK capability or native process. Submit one document for fresh independent review and serial integration. All existing native and physical gates remain.
data.summary:
LUX-85 specification 2: submit one plan candidate for fresh independent review.

Commit: caa937adbf8b2f6426ac8abae01612639c51ee7c.
File: docs/implementation/live-recording-adapter-plan.md.
Bytes: 44805.
SHA-256: 9982c58626025ca529f870919026ac25852f28cbe06ea62173c75aba7538bdf4.

The plan maps I02c3b recording to actual owner calls. It finds no current owner that jointly selects timeline, timed mapping and runtime inputs. It also identifies the mapper's pre-authored trust boundary. The exact first source leaf is I03-P1: a four-file private control prepare/commit seam in the existing worker-control owner. Recording stays gated on a separately reviewed I03 joint-owner/trust protocol. Storage and faithful live replay remain separate.

A bounded actual control-helper probe confirmed a stale selection defect: nested sequence2 is overwritten by outer sequence1 during descriptor reentry. The plan requires stale outer rejection while preserving the nested selection. No application source was edited. No runtime playback, device, native or graphics operation ran. Root must schedule independent review and serial integration before source dispatch.

Fresh independent plan review is required before acceptance.

Recheck source pins and the exact existing control-helper defect. Use bounded CPU helpers only; actual runtime/graphics/native execution is not implied.

Check that the first four-file control prerequisite is independently meaningful, API-consistent and reentry-safe. It must preserve apply callers and captured intrinsics. Check pending-handle replacement and foreign/expired/consumed handle errors; failure must preserve actual nested newer state. Inspect whether all recording requirements remain mandatory behind the missing joint owner and trust boundary.

Check origin of RuntimeKey, accepted source/definition, target UUIDs, seed, source configs, clocks, base/host values and actual selected operation. A caller-created object/hash is not authority. Selection, authored update, render, queue completion and parent receipt must stay separate. A pure tape or state return cannot certify recording or pixels.

Root performs serial plan integration under a separate ticket and records exact landed commit plus document/owner hash match. Root then prepares the I03-P1 source leaf. Do not implement recorder until the separately reviewed and integrated I03 owner protocol exists. Preserve missing physical/provider/storage/runtime/replay gates and LUX7/LUX59 boundaries. No self-acceptance, merge or push by this worker.
